description: Defines an abstract class 'DistanceMeasure' and its implementations for Euclidean and Cosine distances used in Spark's MLlib clustering algorithms, including methods for computing statistics, finding closest centers, and calculating costs.

classes.name: DistanceMeasure
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods for distance calculations and statistics used in clustering algorithms.

classes.name: EuclideanDistanceMeasure
classes.description: Implementation of DistanceMeasure for Euclidean distance, including optimized methods for distance calculations and statistics.

classes.name: CosineDistanceMeasure
classes.description: Implementation of DistanceMeasure for Cosine distance, with methods for computing distances, centroids, and costs.

methods.name: computeStatistics
methods.description: Calculates statistical bounds for centers based on pairwise distances.

methods.name: computeStatisticsDistributedly
methods.description: Computes pairwise center statistics in a distributed manner using SparkContext.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the closest center to a given point, optionally using precomputed statistics.

methods.name: pointCost
methods.description: Returns the clustering cost of a point against centers.

methods.name: isCenterConverged
methods.description: Checks if a center has converged based on epsilon.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Abstract method to compute distance between two vectors.

methods.name: clusterCost
methods.description: Calculates total cluster cost from aggregated properties.

methods.name: updateClusterSum
methods.description: Updates cluster sum with a new point.

methods.name: centroid
methods.description: Computes centroid from sum and weight.

methods.name: symmetricCentroids
methods.description: Generates two symmetric centroids with added noise.

methods.name: cost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of assigning a point to a centroid.
